answer: Require each agent to prove a distinct capability prism: at random intervals it must complete spot tasks spanning coding, negotiation, and data checks, with timing and tool traces recorded. A sybil farm cannot simply mirror one competent agent across many keys, because mirrored traces and identical error patterns expose the cluster, and passing the full prism for each fake identity demands separate training, compute, and upkeep. Like a zephyr that reveals dust in light, these random probes make cheap copies visible while honest single agents pass with work they already do.
